quotes.text: # Langpacks support all CPU architectures. We just need to pick one

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The localized Debian repack kind declares that language packs support all CPU architectures and selects only linux64-shippable/opt as a representative input platform. It depends on shippable-l10n and requests the deb-l10n format. Keep this task selection separate from claims about the Architecture of a generated package. Final package metadata depends on transform and packaging code beyond this comm configuration; no package was built or inspected.
title: A representative build platform does not limit language-pack CPU support
